name: Phantom of the Opera
source:
A mysterious man living in the Opera House and the rumored Phantom. He wears a mask covering half of his face and never shows up in public, only to Christine.
He gives her singing lessons but his intentions are unclear.

[spoiler]His real name is Erik.[/spoiler]
